disclosure: AI tool(s) used: Codex and Claude. Purpose: interface design, code scaffolding, analysis scripts, diagram construction, building the result tables, and drafting the report. Specific contribution: Codex inspected the benchmark interfaces and results, drafted the interface specification and an earlier version of this text, generated the diagram, and wrote and tested the CPU smoke run. Claude revised the reader evidence after reading all four members' 1.3 reports and the sponsor paper's OCSR sections. On October 28 Claude wrote reader_overlap.py and assembly_example.py (reports/1.4-group-report/ in the repository), which compute the reader comparison and the assembly example from committed predictions without rerunning any model, and rewrote the pipeline and Phase 2 sections around their output. Claude also wrote results_tables.py, which builds Tables 1 to 3 from the committed score files, and drafted the results, analysis, conclusions and sponsor questions from the four 1.3 reports, the October 13 sponsor check-in draft and the team comparison table. Will decided to run the pipeline in one environment with MolScribe as the second reader and treated the module assignments as final.
